# Throiy Chess

> Opening traps, mating patterns and top games, explained fast. Short chess lessons (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) about opening traps, how to avoid them, named mating patterns, and key moments from recent top-level games.

## Trap lessons
- [Fishing Pole Trap](https://throiychess.com/traps/fishing-pole-trap/): Black leaves a knight hanging on g4. Take it, and the h-file opens straight onto your king. Opening: Ruy Lopez. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 O-O Ng4 h3 h5 hxg4 hxg4 Nh2 Qh4 f3 g3 Rf2 Nd4 Kf1 gxh2 Ke1 h1=Q+ Bf1 Qxf1+ Kxf1 Qh1#

## Videos
- [All Shorts](https://throiychess.com/shorts/)
- [Free rook? Don't take it! Giri vs Abdusattorov](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/fJiePOSCU9I): Giri left his rook hanging on purpose. Abdusattorov took it, and 19.Nf5! 20.Qg5! decided the game. Before you grab material, check what your opponent gets.
- [Take my queen! The Stafford Gambit trap](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/TsHaDaBUS-c): After 6.Bg5?? Nxe4! 7.Bxd8?? Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4# it's mate. The fix: don't play Bg5, just develop and castle.
- [Don't take the bait! The Fishing Pole Trap](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/G2pqyA0mXF0): Black leaves a knight on g4 as bait. Take it and the h-file opens straight at your king, ending in mate on h1.
- [Fried Liver Attack: mate in 9 (and how to stop it)](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WFRx-dXjOcc): After 5…Nxd5? 6.Nxf7! the black king is dragged out. The fix: don't recapture on d5, play 5…Na5! instead.
- [Don't fall for this Petrov trap](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/KA_x11CO7Gg): After 3…Nxe4? 4.Qe2! the knight is pinned and Nc6+ wins the queen. The fix: play 3…d6 first.
- [Stop the Scholar's Mate (and punish it)](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LCSXV_yJs_U): Block with g6, defend f7 with Nf6, then hit the queen with Nd4. Early queen? Develop and make her run.
- [He moved his king on move 5… big mistake](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/9EOJdMBaPO4): No castling, a knight fork on f7 and a rook gone. In the opening, castle; don't move your king by hand.
- [I fell for the oldest trick in chess](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xF6KVwnOGCY): Queen and bishop against f7. Once they aim at f7, keep defending it.
